about: Territory, patrol and display flights (lane SIG-OTHER), built by scripts/ark-signature-flights.mts from the species catalogue (AnimalDex docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json): each species whose own stored text states a territorial dart from a perch (sally_chase), a low patrol (patrol_low) or a steep-climb-and-glide display flight (display_flight), with the exact sentence. Applied to src/ark-scene/recipes.json by scripts/ark-signature-recipes.mts. held: rows the templates would draw wrongly, and why.

additions.name: Common Wood Pigeon
additions.behaviour: display flight: climbs steeply, claps wings, glides down
additions.quote: In display flight a male climbs steeply, claps its wings, then glides down.
additions.line: {aAnimal} is climbing steeply over the trees, then gliding down

additions.name: Eurasian Collared Dove
additions.behaviour: male's display flight: rises steeply then glides down on spread wings
additions.quote: The male does most of the cooing and performs the display flight, rising steeply and gliding down on spread wings.
additions.line: {aAnimal} is rising steeply, then gliding down on spread wings

additions.name: Spotted Dove
additions.behaviour: display flight: climbs steeply with wing claps, glides down in an arc with tail fanned
additions.quote: A displaying male climbs steeply with loud wing claps, then glides down in a wide arc with his tail fanned.
additions.line: {aAnimal} is climbing steeply, then gliding down in a wide arc

additions.name: Common Rose
additions.behaviour: males patrol a repeated beat and hill-top
additions.quote: Males patrol and hill-top; females spend more time at the host vine.

additions.name: Fox Moth
additions.behaviour: males fly fast and low in afternoon sunshine searching for females
additions.quote: Males fly fast and low in afternoon sunshine searching for females, while females fly at night and come to light.

additions.name: Giant Scoliid Wasp
additions.behaviour: males patrol low over the ground where females will emerge
additions.quote: Males are thought to patrol low over the ground where females are due to emerge.

additions.name: Little Wood-Satyr
additions.behaviour: males patrol woodland paths inspecting every brown shape
additions.quote: Males spend long stretches patrolling woodland paths and edges, inspecting every brown shape that might be a female.

additions.name: Brilliant Blue
additions.behaviour: males perch low on open ground and chase passing butterflies
additions.quote: males often hold a small patch of open ground, perching low and chasing off other butterflies that pass

additions.name: Broad-bodied Chaser
additions.behaviour: male holds a pond-margin perch, flying out to chase rivals and returning
additions.quote: A male holds a stretch of pond margin from a favoured perch, flying out to chase off rival males and coming back to the same spot.

additions.name: Common Flangetail
additions.behaviour: males defend a perch and the water around it, chasing other males
additions.quote: Males defend a perch and the patch of water around it, chasing other males that fly too close.

additions.name: Great Eggfly
additions.behaviour: males perch on a sunlit leaf and chase almost anything that passes
additions.quote: Males perch on a sunlit leaf and chase almost anything that passes.

additions.name: Greater Bee Fly
additions.behaviour: males hold sunlit territories and chase anything of similar size
additions.quote: Males hold small territories in sunlit clearings and chase anything of similar size that crosses them.

additions.name: Hackberry Emperor
additions.behaviour: males perch on sunlit trunks in the afternoon and dart out at passers-by, returning to the same spot
additions.quote: Males perch on sunlit trunks, mainly in the afternoon, and dart out at passing butterflies, and even at people, before returning to the same spot.

additions.name: Mourning Cloak
additions.behaviour: males hold a sunny perch in the afternoon and chase passers-by
additions.quote: Males often hold a sunny perch in the afternoon and chase passing butterflies.

additions.name: Pied Paddy Skimmer
additions.behaviour: male holds a tiny territory on a rice bund, perching low on grass stems
additions.quote: Males are territorial on a very small scale — a bund, not a pond.

additions.name: Red Admiral
additions.behaviour: males hold sunlit afternoon perches and fly up to chase rivals
additions.quote: Males hold sunlit perches in the afternoon and fly up to chase rivals and other passing insects.

additions.name: Scarlet Skimmer
additions.behaviour: male claims a sunny pond edge from a reed tip, chasing rivals and returning
additions.quote: A male claims a sunny stretch of pond edge, perching on a reed tip and darting out to chase rival males before returning to the same spot.

additions.name: Tropical Carpenter Bee
additions.behaviour: males hover in place near flowers or nests and chase off other insects
additions.quote: males are thought to hold small territories near flowers or nest sites, hovering in place and chasing off other insects

additions.name: Two-tailed Pasha
additions.behaviour: male returns to the same high perch after each chase, spiralling up with rivals
additions.quote: A male returns again and again to the same high perch after each chase, spiralling up with rivals before dropping back.
